# HAPI v0.29.0.1

Maintained fork release based on the official HAPI `v0.29.0` tag.

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Rebased the maintained fork on official `v0.29.0` with the official Android, iOS, relay, and desktop workspaces retained.
- Preserved fork-only Pi model/thinking controls, Cursor model-error handling and retry UX, durable queued-message delivery states, session-attached jobs, session pinning, and AGY model discovery.
- Kept the schema migration ladder at `SCHEMA_VERSION = 28`.
- Updated the maintained release process to accept official upstream changes as authoritative instead of replaying them.

## Compared with the official release

- This release is a four-part standalone-binary maintenance build; npm publication is intentionally not used.
- Official upstream behavior is accepted directly. In particular, official `#1320` is retained from the base and is not replayed or manually removed.
- Fork-only behavior was re-audited and recorded in `tools/maintenance/releases/v0.29.0.1/`.
- Fork decisions for `#1091` and `#1093` remain drop; no new open upstream PR is silently replayed.

Release artifacts include platform archives, desktop bundles, and `checksums.txt`.
